about_the_game:
Milf Collection is a fun, light-hearted puzzle game you’ll want to come back to. Pick your dream girl, solve the puzzle, and enjoy intimate scenes crafted with great attention to detail.

Can you solve every puzzle? And more importantly — who will win your heart?

Start the game to find out.

Multiple storylines await, starting with a casual encounter and evolving into something far steamier. Shape the main character’s personality and decide for yourself: will you play the nice guy — or unleash the beast?

The gameplay is quite addictive:
- read the main story;
- make choices in dialogues;
- solve the puzzle to see the spicy content;

Each story is unique and the girls' behavior depends on your choices in the dialogues.

Direct your character using WASD and collect all the “tiles” in 1 try.

🕹 Main features:

💗 73 levels of logic puzzles: the route gets harder with each level.

💃 10 seductive MILFs - from housekeeper to teacher.

🎴 Over 70 explicit images (4 to 16 per character).

🧠 One Way, One Chance mechanic: passed cells disappear, there is no turning back.

📜 Dialogs after each level reveal the characters of heroines.

🖼 A gallery where you can revisit open scenes.

💡 What makes the game special?

Erotic content in high quality anime style.

A unique blend of relaxing but addictive gameplay with rewarding explicit content.

Easy start and progressively increasing difficulty.

⏱️ Duration

The game is designed to take about 3 hours to complete, including all levels and unlocking all stages. Perfect for a relaxing evening session.

content_descriptors.notes:
All characters are of legal age and appear with full consent.
Includes explicit sex scenes, nudity, voyeurism (watching a woman masturbate), public sex, and oral sex.
